source_title: Call of Duty: MW4 Free Download Available for Discord Nitro Subscribers - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players can get an exclusive weapon blueprint through their Discord Nitro subscription, along with other free goodies. The highly anticipated Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 finally launched globally on October 23 after its early-access period was generally well received by fans.
Earlier in August, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 held its beta event, with the first early access weekend reserved for players who had pre-ordered the game. Discord Nitro subscribers were also able to join the early access and try out Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 's multiplayer . Now that the full game is out, Activision and Discord are collaborating once again to bring unique downloadable content to fans, with Nitro users particularly getting an exclusive reward.
How to Get a Free Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Weapon Blueprint with Discord Nitro
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players who have a Discord Nitro subscription can get the exclusive "Code Blurple" weapon blueprint for free right now. To unlock the reward, Discord Nitro users simply need to check their Nitro Home tab on the platform, claim the limited code, and redeem it on Call of Duty 's official website. The blueprint gives players a variant of the Signal 50, a Sniper Rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 's weapon catalog . Players who have already redeemed the blueprint have reported that the Code Blurple weapon can be used in any game mode.
Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer Action Shot Image via GameRant; Source: Activision
Image by Josh Drechsler, Source: Infinity Ward
Aside from the exclusive blueprint for Nitro users, Discord's crossover with Call of Duty is also releasing free rewards for non-subscribers. All Discord users can obtain a bonus Calling Card by linking their account with their Activision account. Additionally, fans can complete Discord's Modern Warfare 4 Quest to get a double XP Token. This reward can be especially useful for players looking to earn XP fast in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . To complete the Quest, fans simply need to accept the challenge on Discord and play the game for 15 minutes. It is unclear how long the collaboration between Discord and Modern Warfare 4 will last, so fans should try to claim these rewards as soon as possible.
The Code Blurple blueprint can be a fun alternative look for the Signal 50, albeit exclusive to Discord Nitro users. Luckily for non-subscribers, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has plenty of camos available to alter a weapon's appearance. Fans can unlock camos by completing challenges in Multiplayer and DMZ. Different Calling Cards can also be unlocked through challenges or by progressing the campaign.
Since its beta weekend, many players have labeled Modern Warfare 4 as one of the best entry in the series yet. The full game's early access has also received praise online. Developer Infinity Ward has already shared a Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 roadmap with a ton of content coming in the following weeks, starting with the divisive yet iconic Shipment map on Tuesday, October 27. Possession Mode and Infected Mode will launch on October 29 and 30, respectively. Finally, Season 1 will kick off on November 6.
